# Python packages for VALENCIA and the conversion of our species table to its input.

# produced the community state types (pip venv ~/valencia_env on the WSL machine,

# `pip install pandas numpy matplotlib`; these pins are what that resolved to.
#
# Left out on purpose: scipy 1.15.3, which that venv also holds but which was added
# later for a downstream analysis script that is not part of this repository.
